text: WeFlow V5 is a standalone, multi-tenant Sprint Management SaaS platform built for creative teams. It evolves from WeFlow V4 — an internal InHive-only tool — into a product any team can sign up for, brand, and use independently.
One tool from sprint kick-off to task completion — no app switching
Personality-aware roles (Creator vs Co-Creator) built into the approval workflow
Real-time sync across all team members via Supabase Realtime channels
Clean, opinionated design system — monochrome + semantic column colours

data: Give every creative team a focused, friction-free sprint OS — built for makers, not managers.
Become the default project OS for India's early-stage creator economy, then scale globally.
1,000 active workspaces with weekly sprint activity within 6 months of public launch.

WeFlow V5 has three roles. Roles are fixed per workspace membership — except Creator who can temporarily toggle to Co-Creator mode per session.

text: SELECT: Any authenticated user whose users.workspace_id matches the row's workspace_id
INSERT: Authenticated user must be a Creator in the workspace (users.role = 'creator')
UPDATE: Creator can update any row. Co-Creator can only update tasks they own (submitted_by = auth.uid())
DELETE: Creator only. Co-Creator and Observer cannot delete any row.
Special: tasks with status = 'pending' — only Creators can read them via wf-pending channel
